name: Kling: Kling 3.0 Turbo
description: Kling 3.0 Turbo is Kuaishou's speed-optimized model in the Kling 3.0 generation, built for fast, cost-efficient video with native audio bundled in. It handles both text-to-video and image-to-video with strong prompt adherence, stable motion, and multi-shot storyboarding (up to six shots in a single generation), and brings a standout lip-sync improvement for natural talking-head and dialogue clips — all at noticeably faster output than the Standard and Pro variants in the same generation. It outputs 720p or 1080p, produces 3–15 second clips, and bills per second with audio included.
